nielsen.name: Match between system and real world

findings.title: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes (1 element) on /index.html
findings.detail: Ensure an element's role supports its ARIA attributes
findings.fix: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes. See the rule guide for code examples.

evidence.text: ARIA attribute is not allowed: aria-expanded="false"

findings.title: No visible focus indicator on 13/25 sampled controls (/index.html)
findings.detail: Keyboard users cannot see where they are on the page.
findings.fix: Never remove outlines without replacement — use :focus-visible with a high-contrast ring.
findings.key: accessibility|No visible focus indicator on #/# sampled controls (/index.html)|/index.html

findings.title: 18 tap/click target(s) smaller than 24×24 px on /index.html
findings.detail: Small targets take longer to acquire and cause mis-taps, especially on touch.
findings.fix: Make targets at least 24×24 px (44×44 px for touch); add padding rather than enlarging icons.
findings.key: efficiency|# tap/click target(s) smaller than #×# px|/index.html

findings.title: ARIA role should be appropriate for the element (1 element) on /index.html
findings.detail: Ensure role attribute has an appropriate value for the element
findings.fix: ARIA role should be appropriate for the element. See the rule guide for code examples.

evidence.text: ARIA role navigation is not allowed for given element

findings.title: Page should contain a level-one heading (1 element) on /index.html
findings.detail: Ensure that the page, or at least one of its frames contains a level-one heading
findings.fix: Page should contain a level-one heading. See the rule guide for code examples.

evidence.text: Page must have a level-one heading

findings.title: 53 interactive elements above the fold on /index.html
findings.detail: A dense first screen competes for attention and dilutes the primary action.
findings.fix: Prioritise one primary call-to-action; reduce or de-emphasise secondary options.
findings.key: cognitive|# interactive elements above the fold|/index.html

findings.title: 36 buttons compete above the fold on /index.html
findings.detail: Without a clear primary action users must evaluate every option.
findings.fix: Use one visually dominant primary button; style the rest as secondary/tertiary.
findings.key: cognitive|# buttons compete above the fold|/index.html

findings.title: 11 different button styles on /index.html
findings.detail: Many visual variants make it unclear which actions are equivalent or primary.
findings.fix: Consolidate into a small set of button variants from a design system (primary / secondary / tertiary / destructive).

findings.principle: Design system — Echo UI (Default, light) · Nielsen #4 Consistency
findings.title: Colour #FFFFFF26 belongs to the other colour mode
findings.detail: Used 3× across 1 page. Closest token: color/background/scrim/muted (dark) #FFFFFF26.
findings.fix: Use the light-mode value of the same semantic token.

findings.principle: Design system — Echo UI (Default, light) · Nielsen #4 Consistency
findings.title: Colour #0088CE belongs to another brand
findings.detail: Used 1× across 1 page. Closest token: the Default theme token (this is Dnata brand: color/light/primary).
findings.fix: Replace with the semantic token the instead of a hard-coded value.

findings.principle: Design system — Echo UI (Default, light) · Nielsen #4 Consistency
findings.title: Colour #FFFFFF1F belongs to the other colour mode
findings.detail: Used 1× across 1 page. Closest token: color/background/scrim/muted (dark) #FFFFFF26.
findings.fix: Use the light-mode value of the same semantic token.

findings.principle: Design system — Echo UI (Default, light) · Nielsen #4 Consistency
findings.title: Spacing 3px (padding) is off the spacing scale
findings.fix: Use the nearest token (2px) instead of a one-off value.

findings.principle: Design system — Echo UI (Default, light) · Nielsen #4 Consistency
findings.title: Shadow does not match any shadow token
findings.detail: Used 2× across 1 page. Closest token: Focus/Default, Focus/Destrcutive, Shadow/xs, Shadow/sm.
findings.fix: Use the nearest token (Focus/Default, Focus/Destrcutive, Shadow/xs, Shadow/sm) instead of a one-off value.

findings.title: 1 custom-built Alert instead of the Echo UI component
findings.detail: 0 of 1 alert components come from the design system. The custom ones differ in: corner #px (spec #px / #px).
findings.fix: Replace them with the Echo UI “Alert” component (Figma node 335:35519) so they pick up the brand theme, states and future updates.

findings.principle: Nielsen #5 & #9 — Error prevention; help users recover
findings.title: 1 console error(s)
findings.detail: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (File not found)
findings.fix: Investigate console errors — they often signal broken features users silently hit.

findings.title: Form fields don't use autocomplete on /index.html
findings.detail: Browsers cannot autofill, forcing users to retype known data.
findings.fix: Add autocomplete tokens (name, email, tel, address-line1…).

findings.title: No H1 heading on /index.html
findings.detail: Users and assistive tech rely on a main heading to confirm where they are.
findings.fix: Add a single, descriptive <h1> that names the page.
